rule.metric: Discovered = first lasting roster. Developed = 0.65 breakout value-gain + 0.35 starts/use − short flips − bench stash.
rule.discovered: First draft / waiver / FA / lasting trade seat. Instant drops (under 21 days, exit drop) are skipped until someone actually rostered them.
rule.developed: Seat that saw the breakout: market flatten gain while owned (exit − acquire), plus lineup starts. Across multiple trades, the seat with the biggest gain + use wins.
rule.use: 0.75 × (your starts / most starts on this player) + 0.25 if you started them first. Used as Developed tie-break / fallback when curve gain is flat.
rule.breakout: max(0, exit flatten − acquire flatten) summed per manager across their stints.
rule.flip: Penalty 1/(1+short stints); short = under 21 days. Pure instant-drop seats with no starts score 0.
rule.bench: Held 21d+ with 0 starts while someone else started them → ×0.35 (or ×0.55 if <3 starts exist).
rule.paid: Highest acquire flatten on/before stint start — fact only, does not crown Developed.
rule.pos_rank: Within-position rank by current-season Sleeper PPR points (QB/RB/WR/TE).
rule.owner_status: Credit winner still owns (held), traded away (trade), or dropped (drop).
